subject.title: `infer model run` leaves a persistent session + transcript on every invocation (unbounded growth)

question: Should gateway `infer model run` probes be ephemeral or hidden from normal session surfaces by default, or should visible pressure-gated probe history remain intentional product behavior?
rationale: Current main deliberately preserves below-cap model-run probe sessions after a maintainer-reviewed cleanup PR, while this issue asks to remove or hide every one-shot probe session from normal user session state.

options.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
options.body: Change gateway model probes so recurring health checks do not create normal client-visible durable sessions by default, while retaining cleanup for rows already created by older releases.

options.title: Keep Visible Probe History
options.body: Treat pressure-gated 24h cleanup as the intended contract and document that recurring probes may remain visible until cap pressure or manual cleanup.

options.title: Add A Filter Or Opt-Out Surface
options.body: Keep persistence but add an approved sessions-list filter or explicit CLI flag after accepting the new public surface.

recommendation.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
recommendation.body: Change gateway model probes so recurring health checks do not create normal client-visible durable sessions by default, while retaining cleanup for rows already created by older releases.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman most recently accepted, reshaped, and merged the related model-run cleanup contract and is the clearest owner for whether to change that lifecycle policy.
